environment.description: Spring Boot 2.7.x application deployed on AWS ECS Fargate behind an Application Load Balancer (ALB). The ALB is internet-facing with no IP-based restrictions. Security groups allow inbound 443 from 0.0.0.0/0. No WAF is attached. The service is accessible from any IP address on the internet. The oauth.allowed-redirect-hosts property is set to 'app.acme.com,portal.acme.com'.
